statusPolicy: This crosswalk contains no mutable status. ADMUX progress is derived from the linked canonical batch, workflow, finding, task, launch-gate, and evidence records.

waves.objective: Collections: Ticket orders + Finance + KPI contracts

tasks.title: Approve Admin UX ADR bundle
tasks.acceptance: All ADRs have a Decided/Deferred status; no downstream phase depends on an unresolved decision; every deferred item has a rationale and launch impact.
tasks.verification: Document review + architecture sign-off.

tasks.title: Create seeded UX regression fixtures
tasks.acceptance: Fixtures can reproduce every critical collection-scale, multi-org, failure-truthfulness and mobile scenario referenced by this plan.
tasks.verification: Fixture smoke run; seed idempotency test.

tasks.title: Restructure first-level Admin IA
tasks.acceptance: Every current Admin destination remains reachable; first-click testing improves for common owner/manager/coordinator tasks; no duplicate primary label represents the same concept; search returns direct matching destinations.
tasks.verification: Route inventory test; first-click usability test; keyboard search test.

tasks.title: Replace custom mobile/collapsed sidebar behavior
tasks.acceptance: One accessible mobile drawer; no internal full reloads; collapsed items have accessible names; body does not scroll behind drawer; stable scope consumes less vertical height.
tasks.verification: axe; VoiceOver/TalkBack; keyboard Escape/focus; navigation no-reload assertion.

tasks.title: Unify acting-organization scope control
tasks.acceptance: Users can identify and switch the organization from any Admin workspace; every mutation still carries the resolved acting context; scope change is visually confirmed before page data mutates.
tasks.verification: Two-org deep-link test; stale-scope mutation negative test.

tasks.title: Implement canonical Admin URL/scope contract
tasks.acceptance: Back/Forward/refresh/share work consistently across representative workspaces; legacy links resolve to canonical state; account scope is never silently changed by a child URL.
tasks.verification: Automated URL matrix; browser history tests; cross-org tamper tests.

tasks.title: Migrate Dashboard navigation state
tasks.acceptance: No full reload for Refresh/row drill-down; copied URL restores the active Dashboard subview; Back returns to the same working state.
tasks.verification: Playwright history/deep-link test.

tasks.title: Migrate Tour portfolio view/filter state
tasks.acceptance: Two sessions opening the same URL see the same working set; Back/Forward restores changes.
tasks.verification: Portfolio deep-link test; saved-view regression.

tasks.title: Normalize Event edit routes
tasks.acceptance: Every edit entry point lands on the same canonical URL and opens the same Event.
tasks.verification: Link inventory + redirect test.

tasks.title: Harden Calendar scope resolution and option loading
tasks.acceptance: Calendar never looks organization-global when narrowed; Org A/B options never cross; option API failure never looks like 'no events'.
tasks.verification: Two-org test; failed-option test; scope deep-link test.

tasks.title: Normalize Staff/Hiring employer scope and Hiring tab URLs
tasks.acceptance: No tab-specific missing-scope surprises; Hiring tab survives refresh/share/back.
tasks.verification: Employer hydration tests; Hiring deep-link tests.

tasks.title: Migrate Ticketing, Finance, Contracts, Communications and Analytics URL state
tasks.acceptance: Each workspace restores exact meaningful state after refresh/share/back; selected Event/conversation/date scope remains visible.
tasks.verification: Parameterized deep-link test matrix.

tasks.title: Publish canonical workspace ownership matrix
tasks.acceptance: Every duplicated domain has one documented source-of-truth UI and an approved embed/deep-link approach.
tasks.verification: Architecture review + route/component crosswalk.

tasks.title: Build canonical Admin header/scope variants
tasks.acceptance: All migrated pages preserve page identity and one primary action from 320px through desktop; record state/scope are visible when relevant.
tasks.verification: Story/fixture coverage; axe; responsive screenshot tests.

tasks.title: Implement universal Admin data-state contract
tasks.acceptance: No migrated P1 surface maps failed primary data to legitimate 0/empty; stale/partial data is visibly labeled; action errors do not replace healthy page state.
tasks.verification: Fault-injection component tests; API-state fixture tests; screenshot assertions.

tasks.title: Create reusable AttentionQueue primitive
tasks.acceptance: More than three issues remain discoverable; internal issue navigation stays SPA-native; Dashboard can aggregate domain queues.
tasks.verification: Seeded attention fixture; link/navigation test.

tasks.title: Fix nested landmarks and viewport sizing
tasks.acceptance: Exactly one main landmark; no double-scroll on target viewports; keyboard scrolling remains predictable.
tasks.verification: axe landmark test; 768px-height + mobile Safari scroll test.

tasks.title: Converge Admin/Workforce/scheduling primitives
tasks.acceptance: No new duplicate primitive family; migrated pages use the same focus/error/loading/action semantics; contracts page no longer double-pads.
tasks.verification: Component inventory; visual regression; a11y tests.

tasks.title: Build structural Admin skeleton variants
tasks.acceptance: Loading preserves major geometry and avoids obvious layout jumps.
tasks.verification: Throttled visual regression.

tasks.title: Define domain-controller decomposition pattern
tasks.acceptance: Event/Tour/Logistics/Comms refactors follow the same boundary rules and unrelated panel failures stay isolated.
tasks.verification: Architecture review + profiler baseline.

tasks.title: Build shared lifecycle/critical-action pattern
tasks.acceptance: High-impact mutations never occur from an unexplained generic select/button; blocked transitions explain why.
tasks.verification: Lifecycle transition tests; keyboard/focus tests.

tasks.title: Standardize touch, icon-action and reduced-motion behavior
tasks.acceptance: Icon-only controls have accessible names/tooltips; critical mobile controls meet comfortable target sizes; Reduce Motion disables decorative movement.
tasks.verification: axe; touch-target scan; prefers-reduced-motion test.

tasks.title: Create canonical responsive AdminDataTable
tasks.acceptance: Representative order/finance tables remain operable at 375px without hidden critical actions.
tasks.verification: Responsive table fixture tests; keyboard/table semantics.

tasks.title: Replace Tour saved-view prompt and unify collection toolbar
tasks.acceptance: No browser prompt; all drafts discoverable; view state is understandable and shareable.
tasks.verification: Saved-view permission/duplicate tests; toolbar task test.

tasks.title: Add Tour pagination, compact mode and authoritative KPIs
tasks.acceptance: 115th tour is discoverable; KPIs match authoritative totals; failed logistics metrics never render as 0%; card actions are accessible.
tasks.verification: >120 record tests; KPI parity; fault injection; mobile card/table tests.

tasks.title: Add Event pagination, compact mode and trustworthy cards
tasks.acceptance: 115th event is discoverable; invalid dates never leak; failed metrics are not zeros; mobile actions remain clear.
tasks.verification: >120 record tests; invalid-date fixture; fault injection; accessibility.

tasks.title: Fix Event attention/export/draft workflows
tasks.acceptance: Attention result set is correct; failed export leaves collection healthy; all drafts are reachable.
tasks.verification: Attention filter test; export fault test; >3 drafts.

tasks.title: Consolidate Ticketing order tables and authoritative export
tasks.acceptance: 30th+ order is searchable; refund view uses same row/action model; CSV includes complete scoped data and escapes fields correctly.
tasks.verification: Order search/paging/refund/export tests.

tasks.title: Build canonical Finance ledger and authoritative export/time series
tasks.acceptance: 200-record ledger is searchable; export/time series match authoritative scope/date data.
tasks.verification: Paging/search; CSV escaping/completeness; time-series parity.

tasks.title: Publish KPI coverage/source-of-truth matrix
tasks.acceptance: No organization-level KPI is computed from a paged visible subset unless explicitly labeled; chart coverage is documented/tested.
tasks.verification: Seed beyond page limits; compare API summaries to DB fixtures.

tasks.title: Rebuild Dashboard information hierarchy
tasks.acceptance: 5-second test reliably identifies urgent work and next action; no repeated global widget blocks.
tasks.verification: Usability test; visual regression.

tasks.title: Unify Dashboard live/freshness status
tasks.acceptance: Disconnecting realtime visibly changes status; last successful update remains available.
tasks.verification: Realtime disconnect/reconnect fixture.

tasks.title: Fix task and mini-calendar interactions
tasks.acceptance: Task API failure never shows all-clear; View All reaches all task domains; every pointer-styled date works; calendar meaning is available without color/hover.
tasks.verification: Fault injection; pointer/keyboard tests; mobile calendar test.

tasks.title: Build hierarchical Admin workspace navigation
tasks.acceptance: Event/Organization/Ticketing workspaces no longer render massive tab walls on mobile; all legacy tab URLs resolve to the correct new location.
tasks.verification: Keyboard/tab semantics; 375px first-click tests; deep-link alias matrix.

tasks.title: Refactor Tour record shell and task hierarchy
tasks.acceptance: Overview loads without unnecessary editor bundles; domain failure is isolated; common tasks need fewer first-level choices.
tasks.verification: Bundle/network profile; domain failure tests; first-click study.

tasks.title: Refactor Event record shell and top-level hierarchy
tasks.acceptance: Mobile navigation is compact; active domain data loads independently; no event identity/status/action duplication.
tasks.verification: Network/effect profile; deep-link matrix; mobile first-click tests.

tasks.title: Make Event child-domain failure states explicit
tasks.acceptance: 403/500 in one child domain never makes it look empty and never blocks unrelated domains.
tasks.verification: Fault-injection matrix; 404/403; visual state snapshots.

tasks.title: Improve Event duplicate and coordinator action semantics
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate retains intended duration; labels match outcome; coordinator action panel no longer acts as a feature list.
tasks.verification: Duplicate fixtures; click-outcome audit.

tasks.title: Turn Event People/Logistics into scoped canonical workspaces
tasks.acceptance: Create shift/review roster/post job require a focused subview; editing logistics from Event/global reaches the same model and returns predictably.
tasks.verification: Cross-entry mutation test; mobile task test.

tasks.title: Refine Staff mobile navigation and scheduling hierarchy
tasks.acceptance: Mobile tabs are named; creating a shift does not require scrolling through exception panels; conflicts/uncovered work are visible before opening subviews.
tasks.verification: Mobile a11y; scheduling task test.

tasks.title: Rebuild Hiring page identity and funnel hierarchy
tasks.acceptance: Deep-link user can identify employer and primary task immediately; low-frequency administration does not compete with funnel work.
tasks.verification: First-click study; healthy/degraded visual tests.

tasks.title: Reorganize Organization's 16-tab governance surface
tasks.acceptance: Owner/admin common tasks have clear first clicks; lower-permission users understand locked capability; no-org CTA solves scope; direct restricted URLs normalize safely.
tasks.verification: Persona capability matrix; deep-link tests; first-click study.

tasks.title: Clarify Logistics taxonomy and lazy data contracts
tasks.acceptance: Overview no longer fetches full data for unused domains; first-click task mapping matches live-event terminology.
tasks.verification: Network profile; first-click test.

tasks.title: Make Logistics scope and metrics truthful/actionable
tasks.acceptance: Operator can identify exact org→tour→event→leg scope; failed source never renders valid zero/not-started; next movement is obvious.
tasks.verification: Multi-scope test; fault injection; 5-second test.

tasks.title: Consolidate duplicate Transport/Travel/Comms/Event logistics surfaces
tasks.acceptance: One clear editor per entity class; Travel tasks stay focused; communications concepts are distinguishable; timeline title matches content.
tasks.verification: Cross-editor parity test; travel/comms first-click tests; metadata-failure test.

tasks.title: Implement responsive unread-first Inbox
tasks.acceptance: 30-conversation mobile flow remains usable; unread work is visible without opening threads; new message elsewhere updates inbox metadata.
tasks.verification: Mobile viewport tests; realtime unread test; keyboard scroll.

tasks.title: Upgrade voice-note and attachment trust UX
tasks.acceptance: Voice note can be canceled/reviewed before send; touch controls are usable; unauthenticated attachment access is rejected.
tasks.verification: Microphone-denied/cancel/preview tests; unauthenticated attachment negative test.

tasks.title: Reorganize Ticketing and lazy-load domain data
tasks.acceptance: Initial request fanout drops; child failure is explicit; first-click ticketing tasks improve; All Events cannot generate synthetic event sharing.
tasks.verification: Network profile; child failure matrix; ticketing first-click tests.

tasks.title: Make Finance truthful and task-oriented
tasks.acceptance: Finance failure is visibly unavailable/stale; one budget flow remains; settlement can be identified by event/tour name/date.
tasks.verification: Finance fault injection; budget parity; settlement lookup test.

tasks.title: Clarify Vendor Master/Contract ownership and naming
tasks.acceptance: Add vendor→assign→contract→obligation flow is understandable and uses one vendor identity.
tasks.verification: Cross-surface journey test; route label test.

tasks.title: Fix Analytics failure, export and realtime scope
tasks.acceptance: Stats failure never looks zero; Org A export/live feed never leaks Org B; export errors are actionable.
tasks.verification: Two-org realtime/export tests; primary stats fault injection.

tasks.title: Run and close cross-surface mobile/a11y migration
tasks.acceptance: No critical/serious axe violations in target routes; all launch-critical workflows are keyboard and mobile operable; responsive tables preserve key identity/actions.
tasks.verification: axe; screen-reader scripts; Playwright viewport suite.

tasks.title: Execute authenticated cross-persona UX journeys
tasks.acceptance: Every launch-critical persona journey passes with no ambiguous scope, false-empty state, broken Back behavior or inaccessible control.
tasks.verification: Full runtime UX scenario suite; video/screenshots/network logs.

tasks.title: Feature-flag and migrate high-risk UX architecture
tasks.acceptance: Legacy bookmarked URLs still work during migration; rollback can restore prior workspace; no data-model destructive migration is required solely for UI changes.
tasks.verification: Flag off/on smoke; alias tests; rollback drill.
